treatments.title: Five things we are asked for most.

sequences.scrollHint: Scroll to move through the steps
sequences.staticHint: Illustration. The step-by-step animation is shown on larger or faster devices.

steps.title: The tooth as it is
steps.text: Turned slightly so you can see the front face and the edge.

steps.title: A 0.4 mm layer
steps.text: Enamel is shaped only where the design needs it. Often less than half a millimetre.

steps.title: The veneer seats
steps.text: A thin porcelain shell slides over the prepared face and is bonded.

steps.title: The shade
steps.text: Shade is chosen with you, from the natural A3 range to the brighter BL2.

steps.title: Bone and gum
steps.text: A cross-section of the jaw where the tooth is missing.

steps.title: The fixture
steps.text: A titanium post is turned into the bone under local anaesthetic.

steps.title: The abutment
steps.text: After healing, a small connector is fitted to the post.

steps.title: The crown
steps.text: A porcelain crown seats on top. It is cleaned like your own tooth.

steps.title: The tray goes on
steps.text: A clear tray fits over the arch. Most people do not notice it.

steps.title: Months 0 to 4
steps.text: Small planned movements start with the most crowded teeth.

steps.title: The starting point
steps.text: Old crowns, worn teeth and a bite that has dropped.

steps.title: One tooth at a time
steps.text: Each failing crown is replaced in turn. Nothing healthy is removed.

steps.title: The bite returns
steps.text: Height is restored so the face and jaw joints rest where they should.

steps.title: From the side
steps.text: The new arch seen in profile.

professor.positioning: The professor of aesthetic dentistry who teaches the dentists other clinics hire.
professor.bio: Prof. Ahmed Zoheir El Hoshy qualified at Cairo University in 1997 and completed his Master's and PhD in Restorative Dentistry there in 2003 and 2007. He taught at Cairo University from 2002 to 2009 and is now Professor at the Faculty of Dentistry, Future University in Egypt. He teaches courses to practising dentists and was the first African and Arab dentist to design a bur for Komet's Ceraline line in Germany. He practises in Heliopolis, facing Cleopatra Hospital, and consults in Arabic, English, French and Italian.
professor.portraitAlt: Portrait of Prof. Ahmed El Hoshy
professor.pageRole: Professor, Faculty of Dentistry, Future University in Egypt. PhD in Restorative Dentistry, Cairo University.
words: I have spent my working life on two things: restoring teeth, and teaching other dentists how to do it. The second keeps the first honest. When you have to explain a decision to a room of postgraduate students, you learn to make decisions you can explain.

In the clinic that means a slower first visit, a plan you can read, and work that is designed to be undetectable rather than impressive. I would rather a patient's friends notice that they look well than notice their teeth.

timeline.text: Bachelor of Oral and Dental Medicine, Cairo University

abroad.title: One trip to Cairo. A written plan before you fly.
abroad.text: Send photographs on WhatsApp. You receive a written plan with visits, days and a quotation within 48 hours. Arrive with every appointment already set, and go home with the work finished and a review scheduled by video.
abroad.quoteNote: Salma R., Egyptian American patient. Paraphrased from a Google review.
abroad.pageLead: Most patients from abroad come for veneers, implants or full mouth work. The plan is agreed in writing before you book a flight, so there are no surprises in the chair.

steps.title: Send photographs on WhatsApp
steps.text: Five photographs of your teeth in daylight and a short note on what you want to change. A video call can follow if useful.

steps.title: A written plan within 48 hours
steps.text: Treatment options, number of visits, days in Cairo and a quotation. Nothing is final until you have read it.

steps.title: Arrive with appointments set
steps.text: Your visits are booked around your flights. A named contact on WhatsApp answers questions before, during and after.

abroad.aftercareText: Review by video and photographs at agreed intervals. Adjustments on a return visit within twelve months are free of charge; laboratory repairs are charged at cost.
abroad.hotelsText: The clinic is in Korba, Heliopolis, facing Cleopatra Hospital. Ask us for hotel suggestions near the clinic when you book.

sections.title: What this website collects
sections.text: Nothing is stored on this website. The booking form composes a WhatsApp message on your device and opens WhatsApp. If an email copy is enabled, the same fields are sent to the clinic by email. Phone and WhatsApp links open your own apps.

sections.title: Analytics
sections.text: If analytics are enabled, the site uses Cloudflare Web Analytics, which does not use cookies or track you across sites. Clicks on WhatsApp, call and booking buttons may be counted in aggregate.

sections.title: Patient images
sections.text: Every case image is published with the patient's written consent, given separately from treatment consent. Patients may withdraw consent at any time by contacting the clinic, and the images are removed.

sections.title: Medical information
sections.text: The content of this site is general information, not medical advice for your situation. A diagnosis and plan require an examination. Results of treatment vary from person to person.
